faqs.q: How do I choose the right CCTV camera?
faqs.a: It depends on where the camera goes, what you need to see, lighting and how you will view footage. Dome cameras suit ceilings and covered areas, bullet cameras suit walls and gates, PTZ cameras cover wide areas, and solar models suit places without power. A short consultation will point you to the right mix.
